Married Woman Climbs Mobile Tower for Lover After Tehsildar Assurance

A married woman in Balia, India, climbed a mobile tower to meet her lover after receiving assurances from the local tehsildar. The incident has raised questions about the role of government officials in facilitating extramarital relationships.
